Best Dermatology Clinic in Ghaziabad, India

admin April 17, 2025

When it comes to skincare, choosing the right dermatologist is crucial for effective treatment and long-term results. If you’re searching for the best dermatology clinic in Raj Nagar Extension, Ghaziabad, Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic is the ultimate destination for all your skin and hair concerns. Led by Dr. Aarushi Tyagi, a highly experienced and skilled dermatologist, the clinic offers advanced dermatological treatments with a patient-centric approach.

If u want to know about us, follow us on Instagram and Facebook.

Why Choose Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic?

1. Experienced and Skilled Dermatologist

Dr. Aarushi Tyagi At the heart of Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic is Dr. Aarushi Tyagi, a renowned dermatologist with years of experience in treating various skin, hair, and nail disorders. Her expertise in both medical and cosmetic dermatology ensures that patients receive the best treatment tailored to their unique needs.

2. Comprehensive Dermatology Services

The clinic offers a wide range of dermatological treatments, addressing both common and complex skin concerns. Some of the key services provided include:

  • Acne and scar treatments
  • Pigmentation and skin brightening treatments
  • Anti-aging procedures (Butox, fillers, and skin rejuvenation)
  • Laser hair reduction
  • Hair fall and PRP therapy
  • Dermatitis and eczema management
  • Skin infection and allergy treatments
  • Chemical peels and carbon facials

With state-of-the-art equipment and personalized care, the clinic ensures effective and safe treatments for all skin types.

3. Advanced Skin & Hair Treatments

Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic stays updated with the latest advancements in dermatology, offering innovative treatments such as:

  • Microneedling with PRP for skin rejuvenation
  • Laser therapies for pigmentation and acne scars
  • Mesotherapy for hair regrowth
  • HydraFacial for deep skin cleansing and hydration

These advanced procedures help patients achieve flawless skin and healthy hair under the expert guidance of Dr. Aarushi Tyagi.

4. Personalized Patient Care

One of the main reasons why Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic is the best dermatology clinic in Raj Nagar Extension, Ghaziabad, is its personalized approach to skincare. Dr. Aarushi Tyagi ensures that each patient receives a customized treatment plan based on their skin type, condition, and lifestyle.

She takes time to understand the root cause of the problem before recommending treatments, ensuring long-lasting and effective results.

5. Safe and Hygienic Environment

Skin treatments require a high level of hygiene and safety standards. Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic follows strict sterilization protocols to ensure a safe and infection-free environment for its patients. From the latest medical equipment to well-maintained treatment rooms, the clinic prioritizes patient safety above all.

If u want to know about us, follow us on Instagram and Facebook.

6. Cutting-Edge Technology and Equipment

The clinic is equipped with the latest dermatological technologies, including:

  • US FDA-approved laser machines for skin and hair treatments
  • High-quality microneedling and PRP kits
  • Advanced diagnostic tools for accurate skin analysis

This ensures that patients receive top-tier treatments with minimal downtime and maximum efficacy.

Treatments Offered at Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic

Acne & Scar Treatment

Acne is one of the most common skin concerns, and Dr. Aarushi Tyagi offers specialized treatments like chemical peels, laser therapy, and medical facials to help patients achieve clear skin.

Pigmentation & Skin Brightening

Uneven skin tone, melasma, and dark spots can be treated with advanced procedures such as laser therapy, chemical peels, and glutathione treatments.

Anti-Aging Treatments

For those looking to reduce fine lines and wrinkles, the clinic provides Butox, fillers, thread lifts, and laser resurfacing to restore a youthful appearance.

Laser Hair Reduction

Unwanted hair growth can be effectively treated with painless and long-lasting laser hair reduction procedures available at the clinic.

Hair Loss & PRP Therapy

For hair thinning and hair loss issues, the clinic offers PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) therapy, mesotherapy, and hair transplant consultations.

Skin Rejuvenation & Hydration

HydraFacial, carbon peels, and microneedling treatments help in deep cleansing, hydration, and collagen stimulation for healthy, glowing skin.

What Patients Say About Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic

Patients who have visited Dr. Aarushi Tyagi at Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic have shared positive reviews about their experiences.

Many appreciate:

  • Personalized consultation and diagnosis
  • Effective and long-lasting skin treatments
  • Hygienic and comfortable clinic environment
  • Friendly and professional staff

These testimonials highlight the clinic’s commitment to excellence in dermatological care.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What skin conditions does Dr. Aarushi Tyagi treat?

Dr. Aarushi Tyagi specializes in treating acne, pigmentation, scars, eczema, psoriasis, hair loss, and other skin concerns.

Is laser hair reduction safe at Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic?

Yes, the clinic uses US FDA-approved laser technology, ensuring safe and effective hair removal.

How can I schedule a consultation with Dr. Aarushi Tyagi?

You can book an appointment online through the clinic’s website or call the clinic to schedule a consultation.

Are the treatments suitable for all skin types?

Yes, Dr. Aarushi Tyagi customizes treatments based on individual skin types and concerns.

What is the cost of treatments at Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic?

The cost varies based on the treatment required. A consultation with Dr. Aarushi Tyagi can help determine the best treatment plan within your budget.

Conclusion

If you are looking for the best dermatology clinic in Raj Nagar Extension, Ghaziabad, Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic is the perfect choice for top-notch skin and hair treatments. With Dr. Aarushi Tyagi’s expertise, state-of-the-art technology, and a patient-centric approach, you can achieve healthy, glowing skin with confidence.
